original: 第四章　奪回荊州
translated: Chuong 4 Chiem lai Kinh Chau

original:
劉備為消滅魏國曹丕，已與東吳結為同盟．
　一心想復興漢室的蜀國，與妄想擴張領土的吳國，各懷鬼胎的兩國終於聯手．
　蜀國重臣，集中到成都會議廳，共謀打敗曹魏的大計．
translated:
De diet tru Nuoc Tao Phi, Luu Bi da lien minh voi Dong Ngo.
Nuoc Thuc muon chan hung Nha Han va Nuoc Ngo muon mo rong lanh tho. Hai nuoc, moi nuoc co chuong trinh nghi su rieng, cuoi cung da hop luc.
Cac quan dai than cua Nuoc Thuc tap trung tai hoi truong Thanh Do am muu danh bai Tao Nguoi.

original: 成都會議廳
translated: Hoi truong Thanh Do

original: 主公，關羽之子關興，張飛之子張苞來見．
translated: Chua Quan Hung con Quan Vu va Truong Bao con Truong Phi den gap vua.

original: 哦，快讓進來．
translated: Oi, vao nhanh di.

original: 是．張苞、關興進來．
translated: Dung. Truong Bao va Quan Hung buoc vao.

original: 我是張飛之子張苞，今後想和父親一樣，為主公效命．
translated: Toi la Truong Bao, con trai Truong Phi. Tu nay tro di, toi muon phuc vu Chua giong nhu cha toi.

original: 我是關羽之子關興，和張苞一樣，也請主公多關照．
translated: Toi la Quan Hung, con trai cua Quan Vu. Giong nhu Truong Bao, xin hay cham soc toi that tot nhe.

original: 你二人，都有乃父之風，以後好好幹吧．
translated: Ca hai deu giong nhu nhung nguoi cha vay nen hay co gang het suc trong tuong lai nhe.

original: 是．臣先告退．
translated: Dung. Toi se nghi huu truoc.

original: 嗯，父親，我已長大成人，也要去打仗嗎？
translated: Thua Cha, bay gio con da truong thanh roi va con co phai ra tran khong?

original: 我如果把你編排在部隊裡，當然要去打仗．你不願意嗎？
translated: Neu toi dua ban vao quan doi, tat nhien ban se ra tran. Ban khong muon sao?

original: 不，不是！沒那麼想……好吧，我先退下了……真煩人……
translated: Khong, khong phai vay! Toi khong nghi vay... Duoc roi, toi se nghi viec ngay bay gio... Kho chiu qua...

original: 孔明，如此安排行嗎？
translated: Khong Minh, su sap xep nay on chu?

original: 以後如不好生培養，恐不能成大器．他好像還不懂得戰爭的嚴酷，主公，我還有要事與您商量……
translated: Neu ban khong trau doi chung tot trong tuong lai, ban co the khong the tro thanh mot nguoi vi dai. Anh ta duong nhu khong hieu duoc su khoc liet cua chien tranh. Thua ngai, toi co chuyen quan trong can ban voi ngai...

original: 已與東吳結盟，這樣就只有魏國是敵人了．
translated: Da lien minh voi Dong Ngo nen chi co Nuoc Nguoi la ke thu.

original: 嗯，必須伐魏，復興漢室．
translated: Thoi, chung ta phai danh bai Nguy va hoi sinh nha Han.

original: 二哥的仇不能忘，但復興漢室是頭等大事，二哥一定也是這麼想的．
translated: Moi thu cua anh hai khong the quen nhung viec vuc day nha Hann la uu tien hang dau. Nguoi anh thu hai chac han cung nghi vay.

original: 盡快伐魏吧．
translated: Hay danh bai Wei cang som cang tot.

original: 決戰的時刻終於到了，請看我一展身手吧．
translated: Thoi diem dien ra tran chien quyet dinh cuoi cung da den, hay xem toi the hien ky nang cua minh nhe.

original: 我絕不落在黃忠和其他將軍後面．
translated: Toi se khong bao gio thua kem Hoang Trung va cac tuong khac.

original: 到魏國洛陽，有兩條路可走，一條是從荊州的襄陽走，另一條是從漢中取道關中長安．
translated: Co hai cach de di den Nuoc Nguoi Lac Duong, mot la tu Tuong Duong o Kinh Chau, hai la tu Han Trung qua Quan Trung Truong An.

original: 荊州和關中都有魏國精銳把守．
translated: Ca Kinh Chau va Quan Trung deu do gioi thuong luu nuoc Nguoi canh giu.

original: 當然．孔明，你認為如何攻擊為上？
translated: chac chan. Khong Minh, nguoi nghi phuong phap tan cong tot nhat la gi?

original: 既然已與東吳結盟，從襄陽一路與東吳共同進攻為上．但漢中也會因此而薄弱，得向關中派遣奇襲隊，在那裡絆住魏軍．
translated: Vi da lien minh voi Dong Ngo nen tot nhat la cung Dong Ngo tu Tuong Duong tan cong den cung. Nhung Han Trung cung vi the ma suy yeu, phai sai quan tan cong bat ngo vao Quan Trung de danh quan Nguy o do.

original: 軍師所言極是．但是，我軍兵力比魏軍少，又如此分兵兩路，豈不危險？
translated: Nhung gi co van quan su noi la hoan toan dung. Tuy nhien, quan ta co it quan hon quan Nguy, chia quan thanh hai phe co nguy hiem khong?

original: 我也考慮過．奇襲隊的主帥一定得派精明強悍的人．至於派不派奇襲隊，請主公定奪，宜深思熟慮之．
translated: Toi cung da xem xet no. Huan luyen vien truong cua Raiders phai cu nhung nguoi thong minh va manh me den. Ve viec co nen phai doi tan cong bat ngo hay khong, la do Chua quyet dinh, can phai can nhac ky luong.

original: 向關中派兵是可以，但如果那樣……就得分兵，可是我們哪裡有那麼多人馬可分呀？
translated: Dua quan den Quan Trung thi duoc, nhung neu dieu do xay ra... chung ta se phai chia quan. Nhung chung ta co nhieu nguoi nhu vay de chia re o dau?

original: 是呀……誠如軍師所言，我也認為有必要分兵．
translated: Dung... Nhu co van quan su da noi, toi cung nghi viec chia quan la can thiet.

original: 我想跟隨主公一齊作戰．
translated: Toi muon chien dau voi chua te cua toi.

original: 關中嗎？關中是漢中以北一帶的總稱，陳倉和長安等處也屬關中．
translated: Quan Trung? Guanzhong la ten goi chung cua khu vuc phia bac Han Trung. Tran Tang, Truong An cung thuoc Quan Trung.

original: 主公，下決定了嗎？
translated: Thua ngai, ngai da quyet dinh chua?

original: 奇襲隊的主帥，派龐統是合適人選．
translated: Voi tu cach la huan luyen vien truong cua Raiders, Pai Bong Thong la ung cu vien phu hop.

original: 嗯，快喚龐統來．
translated: Nao hay goi cho Bong Thong nhanh nhe.

original: 主公，找我何事？
translated: Lay Chua, Chua muon gi o con?

original: 龐統，你來指揮關中奇襲隊．
translated: Bong Thong, nguoi toi chi huy doi dot kich Quan Trung.

original: 決定向關中出兵了吧．
translated: Ban da quyet dinh dua quan den Quan Trung chua?

original: 不錯，你所料極是．
translated: Vang, do chinh xac la nhung gi ban mong doi.

original: 得令．我馬上去陽平關．
translated: Da nhan duoc don dat hang. Toi se toi deo Yangping ngay.

original: 嗯，帶趙雲等人同去吧．
translated: Thoi, hay dua Trieu Van va nhung nguoi khac di cung.

original: 是，我先去了．
translated: Vang, toi da di dau tien.

original: 奇襲隊的主帥，趙雲是合適人選．
translated: Huan luyen vien truong Raiders Trieu Van la su lua chon dung dan.

original: 嗯，快喚趙雲來．
translated: Thoi, goi Trieu Van nhanh len.

original: 趙雲，你來指揮關中奇襲隊．
translated: Trieu Van, nguoi se chi huy doi dot kich Guanzhong.

original: 嗯，帶馬超等人同去吧．
translated: Thoi, hay dua Ma Sieu va nhung nguoi khac di cung.

original: 是，全軍進發荊州吧．
translated: Vang, hay cho toan quan tien ve Kinh Chau.

original: 那，去東吳邀請共同發兵吧．
translated: Sau do ve Dong Ngo moi ta cung gui quan.

original: 嗯，全靠你了．
translated: Vang, tat ca phu thuoc vao ban.

original: 是．
translated: Dung.

original: 另一方面，在魏國的大本營鄴城，正在商議對付蜀吳同盟．
translated: Mat khac, o Nghiep Thanh, can cu cua Nuoc Nguoi, dang tien hanh cac cuoc thao luan de doi pho voi Lien minh Thuc-Ngo.

original: 陛下，蜀吳已結成同盟，很明顯要共同進攻我們，我們如何應付？
translated: Be ha, Thuc va Ngo da thanh lap mot lien minh va ro rang la se cung nhau tan cong chung ta. Chung ta nen giai quyet no nhu the nao?

original: 嗯，派援軍去襄陽．那，夏侯惇．
translated: Thoi, gui quan tiep vien den Tuong Duong. Do la Ha Hau Don.

original: 在！
translated: hien huu!

original: 馬上率軍增援襄陽，與襄陽守將曹仁協力，頂住蜀軍．
translated: Ong lap tuc dan quan den tiep vien cho Tuong Duong va hop suc voi thi ve cua Tuong Duong la Tao Nhan de chong lai quan Thuc.

original: 遵命，我馬上去！
translated: Vang, toi se di ngay!

original: 還有，曹洪、賈詡．
translated: Ngoai ra con co Tao Hong, Jia Xu.

original: 在．
translated: hien huu.

original: 有何吩咐．
translated: Don dat hang cua ban la gi?

original: 曹洪，你去關中向曹真傳命，敵人若攻來就迎擊，否則就增援襄陽．
translated: Dao Hong, nguoi toi Quan Trung truyen lenh cho Tao Chan. Neu ke thu tan cong, hay tan cong anh ta. Nguoc lai thi tiep vien Tuong Duong.

original: 賈詡去合淝，向張遼也照此傳令．
translated: Gia Hu den Hop Phi va sai nguoi truyen lenh cho Truong Lieu.

original: 遵命．
translated: Tuan theo.

original: 夏侯惇遵曹丕之命，已到達曹仁鎮守的襄陽．
translated: Ha Hau Don theo lenh Tao Phi den Tuong Duong, noi Tao Nhan dang tran giu.

original: 奉聖上之命，前來增援．
translated: Theo lenh cua Dang Thanh, chung toi den de tiep vien cho ban.

original: 來得太好了，光我們這些兵，根本守不住．
translated: Tot qua, mot minh nguoi linh chung toi khong the nao cam cu noi.

original: 提早禦敵吧．
translated: Bao ve ke thu som.

original: 是呀，敵人隨時都可能殺來．
translated: Vang, ke thu co the den bat cu luc nao.

original: 那好，夏侯惇去守宛城．
translated: Thoi, Ha Hau Don di bao ve Uan Thanh.

original: 我守最後的關口，好的．
translated: Toi se bam chat vao rao can cuoi cung, duoc chu.

original: 徐晃守南郡，于禁守新野，都要用心防守．
translated: Xu Huang canh giu Nanjun va Yujin canh giu Tan Da, vi vay anh ta phai bao ve bang ca trai tim.

original: 主公，我剛從東吳回來．
translated: Thua Thay, con vua o Dong Ngo ve.

original: 先請聽聽馬良的報告吧．
translated: Xin hay nghe Ma Liang bao cao truoc.

original: 大哥，聽聽報告吧．
translated: Anh em hay nghe bao cao nhe.

original: 主公，有沒有東吳參加無所謂，有我在就夠了．
translated: Thua ngai, Dong Ngo co tham gia hay khong khong quan trong, chi can toi o day la du.

original: 與東吳交涉很順利吧．
translated: Cuoc dam phan voi Dong Ngo dien ra suon se.

original: 馬良，聯合起兵的事如何了？
translated: Ma Luong, lien quan the nao roi?

original: 已大功告成，孫權答應聯合起兵了．
translated: Lam xong, Ton Quyen dong y lien thu.

original: 哦，真是好消息．
translated: O, that la tin tot.

original: 孫權要去江陵．
translated: Ton Quyen di Giang Lang.

original: 好，那我們也去江陵．
translated: Duoc roi chung ta cung di Giang Lang nhe.

original: 出發吧．
translated: Di thoi.

original: 江陵議事廳
translated: Hoi truong Giang Lang

original: 主公，孫權到達江陵了．
translated: Thua ngai, Ton Quyen da den Giang Lang.

original: 是嗎，請到這裡來．
translated: That su? Xin vui long den day.

original: 東吳……．關羽遭東吳毒手時，哪裡想到今日會與孫權聯合攻曹魏．
translated: Dong Ngo……. Khi Quan Vu bi Dong Ngo ha doc, han khong bao gio nghi rang hom nay se hop suc voi Ton Quyen tan cong Tao Nguoi.

original: 主公的英明決斷，才造成今日的有利局勢．主公，孫權好像已經到了．
translated: Quyet dinh sang suot cua chua da dan den tinh hinh thuan loi nhu ngay nay. Chua oi, Ton Quyen hinh nhu da toi.

original: 劉備公，幸會幸會．
translated: Ong Luu Bi, rat vui duoc gap ong.

original: 先聽孫權公妙策吧．
translated: Truoc tien hay nghe loi khuyen tuyet voi cua Ton Quyen.

original: 大哥，先問客人吧．
translated: Anh oi, hay hoi khach truoc da.

original: 主公，先聽孫權公妙策吧．
translated: Thua ngai, xin hay nghe loi khuyen tuyet voi cua anh Ton Quyen truoc da.

original: 我率部來此，只為伐魏．我先介紹一下我軍統帥陸遜．陸遜，有請．
translated: Toi dan quan toi day chi de danh Nguy. Truoc tien hay de toi gioi thieu ve chi huy quan doi cua chung toi Luc Ton. Luc Ton, lam on.

original: 在下陸遜，大家一回生，二回熟．
translated: Day la Luc Ton, moi nguoi deu quen thuoc.

original: 孫權公，陸遜公，我們一起伐魏，共誅國賊吧．
translated: Ong Ton Quyen, ong Luc Ton, chung ta cung nhau danh Nguy, diet bon phan quoc.

original: 好吧．消滅了曹丕，天下也就太平了．
translated: Duoc roi. Neu Tao Phi bi loai bo thi the gioi se hoa binh.

original: 我們也會盡力伐魏．
translated: Chung toi cung se co gang het suc de danh bai Nguy.

original: 一同伐魏吧．
translated: Hay cung nhau danh bai Nguy.

original: 要與東吳一起作戰？在此之前，想都不敢想．
translated: Muon danh nhau voi Dong Ngo? Truoc do, toi tham chi khong the nghi ve no.

original: 請孫權派奇襲隊，分散敵軍兵力為好．
translated: Se tot hon neu yeu cau Ton Quyen cu doi tan cong bat ngo de phan tan luc luong cua ke thu.

original: 讓奇襲隊進攻何處呢？
translated: Raiders nen tan cong o dau?

original: 東吳之北是合淝，由張遼鎮守．如果進攻合淝，張遼就不能抽身增援他處．請主公熟思決斷．
translated: Phia bac Dong Ngo la Ha Phi, do Truong Lieu tran giu. Neu cuoc tan cong khep lai, Truong Lieu se khong the rut quan tiep vien di noi khac. Xin Chua hay suy nghi ky va dua ra quyet dinh.

original: 主公，考慮得如何了？
translated: Thua ngai, ngai dang nghi the nao?

original: 孫權公，派奇襲隊如何？
translated: Ton Quyen dai nhan, cu doi tan cong bat ngo thi sao?

original: 奇襲隊？
translated: Ke dot kich?

original: 想請您進攻東吳北面的合淝．
translated: Toi muon yeu cau ban tan cong Hop Phi o phia bac Dong Ngo.

original: 讓我牽制敵軍．好，我發兵合淝．
translated: Hay de toi kiem che ke thu. Duoc roi, toi se cu quan cua minh hop luc.

original: 那好，我馬上回去，做發兵合淝的準備．
translated: Duoc roi, toi se quay lai ngay va chuan bi gui quan va hop luc.

original: 我軍想資助些軍需，請笑納．
translated: Quan doi chung toi co nhu cau ho tro mot so vat tu quan su, xin vui long chap nhan.

original: 以後有什麼事，請吩咐陸遜．那我先告退．
translated: Sau nay co chuyen gi xin hay bao cho Luc Ton biet. Vay thi toi se roi di truoc.

original: 那我們也準備出征吧．
translated: Sau do hay chuan bi cho cuoc tham hiem.

original: 出征嗎？
translated: Di tham hiem a?

original: 請編組部隊．
translated: Hay to chuc quan doi cua ban.

original: 首先進攻離此最近的襄陽吧．
translated: Truoc tien hay tan cong Tuong Duong, noi gan day nhat.

original: 蜀軍就要攻來了！一定要擋住他們！
translated: Quan Thuc sap tan cong! Hay chac chan de ngan chan chung!

original: 聽說敵軍主將是曹仁．攻下襄陽，再奪回荊州．
translated: Nghe noi tuong giac la Tao Nhan. Danh chiem Tuong Duong, chiem lai Kinh Chau.

original: 大家不要落在蜀軍後面！向天下顯示吳軍的實力！
translated: Dung tut lai phia sau quan Thuc! Cho the gioi thay suc manh cua Wu Jun!

original: 哦，援軍來了嗎？大家加把勁！援軍已到，一鼓作氣殺回去！
translated: O, quan tiep vien dang den a? Moi nguoi hay co gang hon nua nhe! Luc luong tiep vien da den. Hay chien dau tro lai trong mot lan!

original: 沒想到……敵人的援軍到了．
translated: Khong ngo... quan tiep vien cua dich da den.

original: 進襄陽城吧．
translated: Vao thanh pho Tuong Duong.

original: t曹仁，久違了．
translated: t Tao Nhan, da lau khong gap.

original: 哦，何人？你……，是你！還活著！？
translated: O, ai co? Anh..., chinh la anh! Van con song! ?

original: t我怎會這麼容易就死，現在我要雪荊州之恨！
translated: Lam sao ta co the chet de dang nhu vay, hien tai ta muon bao thu cho Kinh Chau!

original: 哼！來吧！
translated: khit mui! mang no len!

original: 我來也！
translated: Toi cung toi day!

original: t好小子！你哪裡是我的對手！
translated: t Cau be ngoan! Ban la doi thu cua toi nhu the nao?

original: 哇！
translated: O!

original: 怎麼？發生了什麼事？
translated: Lam sao? Chuyen gi da xay ra the?

original: 敵人內鬨了？一定要抓住這個時機！
translated: Ke thu co dang do danh khong? Hay chac chan de nam bat co hoi nay!

original: 好，猛勁殺過去！
translated: Duoc roi, giet no that manh!

original: 可、可惡……劉備小兒！哇！！
translated: Chet tiet, chet tiet... Luu Bi, nhoc! O! !

original: 好，殺了曹仁！
translated: Duoc roi, giet Tao Nhan!

original: t……我哪有面目去見兄長……
translated: t...Lam sao toi co the mat mui nhin thay anh trai minh...

original: 嗯！那是……？莫非……
translated: Um! Do co phai la...? Co the nao...

original: 大哥，怎麼了？
translated: Anh trai, co chuyen gi the?

original: 奇怪……沒什麼……
translated: Ky la...khong co gi...

original: 大哥，不舒服嗎？高興點．
translated: Anh oi, anh co thay kho chiu khong? Hay hanh phuc.

original: 是呀．（肯定是看花眼了，莫非……）好，進襄陽吧！
translated: Dung. (Chac minh hoa mat lam phai khong...) Duoc roi, chung ta di Tuong Duong thoi!

original: 那就進襄陽城吧．
translated: Sau do vao thanh pho Tuong Duong.

original: 襄陽議事廳
translated: Hoi quan Tuong Duong

original: 恭喜主公，終於又奪回了襄陽．
translated: Chuc mung chua vi cuoi cung da chiem lai duoc Tuong Duong.

original: 雖然打敗了曹仁，但若要打到洛陽，還得先攻下宛城，於路上，敵人也會嚴陣以待．
translated: Tao Nhan tuy bai tran nhung muon den duoc Lac Duong thi truoc tien phai chiem duoc Uan Thanh. Tren duong di, ke thu se chuan bi tot.

original: 大哥，二哥雖已過世，但總覺得他還活著．
translated: Du nguoi anh ca va nguoi anh thu hai da qua doi nhung toi luon cam thay anh van con song.

original: 賀喜主公，能重奪襄陽．
translated: Chuc mung chua vi da lay lai duoc Tuong Duong.

original: 初次相見，我乃東吳之臣甘寧．以後，我們會相處的很好的．
translated: Lan dau tien chung ta gap nhau, toi la Cam Ninh, thua tuong Dong Ngo. Tu gio tro di, chung ta se rat hop nhau.

一、徐晃的撤退．

original: 來不及了……

translated: Trai Tan Da

original: 陸遜大人，辛苦了．
translated: Ngai Luc Ton, cam on ngai da lam viec cham chi.

original: 此須小事，何足掛齒．蜀軍如此強大，也讓人驚奇．劉備公，我主有令，命我返回，實在對不起……

translated: Theo lenh cua Thong doc Luc Ton, toi, Cam Ninh, Xu Sheng va Dinh Phong se o lai day de chien dau ben canh Cong tuoc Luu Bi va tuan theo menh lenh cua ban.

original: 哎呀！不能去增援夏侯惇了，可惡！

original: 二哥，今日暢飲一番！來，舉杯！
translated: Anh hai, hom nay uong mot ly di! Nao, nang ly nao!

original: 很久沒和你喝酒了，今日不醉不休！
translated: Da lau roi toi khong uong ruou voi anh, hom nay toi se khong ngung say!

original: 這樣對嘍，好吧，兄長，我等你．
translated: Dung roi, duoc roi anh trai, em se doi anh.

original: 主公，魏國丟掉這個宛城，肯定會驚惶失措．一口氣進攻吧．
translated: Thua ngai, neu Nuoc Nguoi mat Uan Thanh nay chac chan se hoang so. Tan cong trong mot lan.

original: 此言極是，但是，現在還是等關中的奇襲隊吧，如果不與他們會合，很難戰勝魏軍精銳．
translated: Dieu nay rat dung, nhung bay gio chung ta nen doi doi tan cong bat ngo o Guanzhong. Neu chung ta khong tham gia cung ho, se kho danh bai quan Nguy tinh nhue.

original: 龐統他們不會出什麼事吧……
translated: Se khong co chuyen gi xay ra voi Bong Thong va nhung nguoi khac...

original: 趙雲他們不會出什麼事吧……
translated: Se khong co chuyen gi xay ra voi Trieu Van va ho...

original: 奇襲隊早點到達才好．
translated: Se tot hon neu doi dot kich den som.

original: 等奇襲隊吧．
translated: Cho doi doi bat ngo.

original: 話說兩頭，在漢中的陽平關，劉備軍奇襲隊已佈下陣勢．
translated: O hai dau truyen, tai deo Duong Binh o Han Trung, doi tan cong bat ngo cua quan Luu Bi da bo tri doi hinh.

original: 大概主力部隊正順利進攻洛陽，如果這樣下去，將在許昌決戰吧．
translated: Chac quan chu luc dang tan cong Lac Duong thanh cong. Neu cu tiep tuc nhu vay, tran chien quyet dinh se dien ra o Ho Hu.

original: 軍師，我們也別晚了，趕快去與主力部隊會合吧．
translated: Co van quan su, dung de qua muon. Hay nhanh chong den gap quan chu luc thoi.

original: 是啊，已完成虛攻的任務，已沒有必要待在這裡了？
translated: Dung vay, nhiem vu tan cong gia da hoan thanh, khong can phai o lai day nua?

original: 可是，不能放著關中、長安魏軍不管，否則，主力部隊的背後就會遭到襲擊．能打擊多少就打擊多少吧．
translated: Tuy nhien, quan Nguy o Quan Trung va Truong An khong the de yen, neu khong chu luc se bi tan cong tu phia sau. Chi can danh manh nhat co the.

original: 那，趕快出擊吧．
translated: Sau do, tan cong nhanh chong.

original: 嗯，但是別太浪費時間，與主力部隊會合才是最重要的．
translated: Dung vay, nhung cung dung lang phi qua nhieu thoi gian, gap duoc quan chu luc la quan trong nhat.

original: 趙將軍，我們也別晚了，趕快去與主力部隊會合吧．
translated: Tuong quan Trieu, dung qua muon, hay nhanh chong hoi quan voi quan chu luc.

original: 出擊吧．
translated: Tan cong.

original: 知道了．
translated: da biet.

original: 蜀軍終於攻來了，但是別想從陳倉這裡過去，有種的過來一戰！
translated: Quan Thuc cuoi cung cung tan cong, lai khong nghi toi viec vuot qua Tran Tang. Neu ban co du can dam, hay den va chien dau!

original: 陳倉乃咽喉要地，別浪費時間！火速攻下！
translated: Tran Tang la mau chot, dung lang phi thoi gian! Hay tan cong nhanh chong!

original: 魏軍乃逆賊．我是不是助紂為虐了．
translated: Quan Nguy la ke phan boi. Toi co dang giup do ke ac khong?

original: 來將可是敵方統帥．來得正好，單挑！
translated: Tuong la tong tu lenh cua dich. Dung luc de dau tay doi!

original: 可惡……！讓你們打到這裡，只有決一勝負！
translated: dang ghet……! Hay de ban chien dau o day, lua chon duy nhat la quyet dinh ket qua!

original: 不愧是統帥！好厲害！
translated: Dung nhu mong doi tu tong tu lenh! That tuyet voi!
Chao……!

original: 哈、哈……
translated: Ha ha……

original: 看招！
translated: Xem di chuyen!

original: 啊！不好！
translated: a! khong tot!
O! ..., ..., ...? Toi van con song chu?

original: 啊！心，心臟……在這種……地方……犯老病……．
translated: a! Trai tim, trai tim... dang mac benh cu o...noi nay...

original: 怎麼回事？
translated: Chuyen gi dang xay ra vay?

original: 不好……．因病……倒下……．
translated: khong tot……. Suy sup vi benh tat….

original: 好險啊！
translated: That nguy hiem!

original:
劉備軍奇襲隊擊斃郝昭，
　佔領陳倉．
translated:
Doi tan cong bat ngo cua quan Luu Bi giet chet Hao Chieu,
Chiem Tran Tang.

original: 不能再待在魏軍了！我姜維現在加入蜀軍！
translated: Chung ta khong the o lai quan Nguy duoc nua! Ta Tuong Vi nay gia nhap quan Thuc!

original: 你們可是羌族人？為何跟著魏軍，阻擋我軍前進！
translated: Cac ban co phai la nguoi Khuong khong? Tai sao cac nguoi lai di theo quan Nguy va ngan can quan ta tien len!

original: 啊，您是馬超將軍！聽說您被魏軍殺害了，看來平安無事呀！
translated: A, ong la tuong Ma Sieu! Ta nghe noi nguoi da bi quan Nguy giet chet. Co ve nhu ban van binh an vo su!

original: 當然，哪能那麼容易就死了．
translated: Tat nhien, ban khong the chet de dang nhu vay.

original: 我們不打算與馬超將軍作對，現在我們羌族加入您那一方．
translated: Chung toi khong co y dinh chong lai tuong Ma Sieu, bay gio nguoi Khuong chung toi ve phe cac ong.

original: 馬超的等級上升！
translated: Ma Sieu thang cap!

original: 不行，要趕不上決戰了！全軍，加速前進！
translated: Khong, toi se khong the bat kip tran chien quyet dinh! Toan quan, tang toc va tien len!

original: 可惡！這樣趕不上決戰了！
translated: dang ghet! Bang cach nay, chung ta khong the bat kip tran chien quyet dinh!

original: 可惡．擋不住劉備軍，我與陣地共存亡．
translated: dang ghet. Khong ngan duoc quan Luu Bi, ta se song chet voi vi the.

original: 得到黃金１６００！
translated: Co 1600 vang!

original: 好，快進攻長安！
translated: Duoc roi, tan cong Truong An nhanh len!

original: 在這裡箝制住蜀軍！不能讓蜀軍再為所欲為了．
translated: Kep quan Thuc vao day! Chung ta khong the de quan Thuc muon lam gi thi lam nua.

original: 越過長安，馬上就到洛陽了．大家再加把勁！
translated: Qua Truong An chung ta se den Lac Duong ngay. Moi nguoi hay lam viec cham chi hon nhe!

original: 當初玄德公的實力何其渺小，現在如此壯大……我的眼光果然沒錯．
translated: Huyen Duc Cong luc dau thuc luc nho nhu vay, bay gio lai cuong dai nhu vay... Ta nhin qua nhien la dung.

original: 已經打進城裡了！各軍要迎擊敵軍！！不惜一切要阻止敵軍去許昌與主力會合！
translated: Da vao thanh pho roi! Tat ca quan doi phai gap ke thu! ! Lam bat cu dieu gi can thiet de ngan chan ke thu tiep can Hu Xu va gap quan chu luc!

original: 且慢，不要打！我乃徐庶，現在回歸蜀軍．
translated: Doi da, dung danh nhau! Toi la Tu Thu, toi dang tro ve quan Thuc.

original: 那邊可是張郃！
translated: Do la Zhang He o do!

original: 趙雲嗎？久違了，有何事指教？來勸降？別開這種玩笑．
translated: Trieu Van? Da lau roi, toi co the noi gi voi ban? Den thuyet phuc han dau hang? Dung lam tro dua nhu vay.

original: 張郃，乾脆投降吧！魏國亡定了．
translated: Truong Hach, dau hang di! nuoc Nguoi chet roi.

original: 別逗了，我自棄袁紹效力曹公，絕不會再投降了．
translated: Dung dua, ta da bo Vien Thieu de phuc vu Tao cong, ta se khong bao gio dau hang nua.

original: 那就打吧！
translated: Sau do chien dau!

original: 啊！不愧……是……趙雲，我不行了！
translated: a! Qua nhien... La... Trieu Van, toi khong the lam duoc nua!

original: ……張郃，真乃義士．
translated: ...Zhang He thuc su la mot nguoi dan ong chinh truc.

original: 不好，趕不上決戰了！全軍，加速前進！
translated: Khong, toi khong the den kip tran chien quyet dinh duoc! Toan quan, tang toc va tien len!

original: 糟了！這樣要趕不上決戰了．
translated: Oi! Bang cach nay, chung ta se khong the bat kip tran chien quyet dinh.

original: 蜀軍太厲害了……！啊！
translated: Quan Thuc hung manh qua...! a!

original: 好，馬上進軍洛陽！
translated: Nao, hay den Lac Duong ngay bay gio!

original: 劉備等人在宛城的議事廳召開會議，商議伐魏．
translated: Luu Bi va nhung nguoi khac to chuc hop tai hoi truong Uan Thanh de ban viec danh bai quan Nguy.

original: 主公，關中的魏軍已移動到洛陽．
translated: Thua chua, quan Nguy o Quan Trung da tien vao Lac Duong.

original: 敵人要在洛陽防守．
translated: Ke thu muon bao ve Lac Duong.

original: 已經打到這裡，沒有可猶豫的，進軍洛陽！
translated: Da toi diem nay thi khong can phai chan chu nua, chung ta hay chuyen tiep den Lac Duong nhe!

original: 奇襲隊還沒任何消息，大概被魏軍絆住了．
translated: Van chua co tin tuc gi ve doi tan cong bat ngo, co the ho da bi quan Nguy vay bat.

original: 如果再等奇襲隊來，只會給敵人時間加固設防．
translated: Neu chung ta doi doi tan cong bat ngo den, dieu do se chi cho ke dich co thoi gian de tang cuong phong thu.

original: 正是，很遺憾，但也別無他法．他們不久就會趕到，曹丕在許昌，我們先發兵許昌．
translated: Dung la dang tiec nhung khong con cach nao khac. Ho se den som thoi. Tao Phi o Ho Xu. Chung ta se dua quan toi Hu Xu truoc.

original: 主公，剛接到報告，奇襲隊已達到洛陽．
translated: Thua ngai, chung toi vua nhan duoc tin bao nhom dot kich da den Lac Duong.

original: 好樣的，馬上與奇襲隊合兵一處，一口氣直攻許昌．
translated: Lam tot lam, chung toi lap tuc hop luc voi doi tan cong bat ngo va tan cong Hu Xu mot luot.

original: 好！全軍準備出征，直指許昌！
translated: Tot! Toan quan san sang xong ra tan cong Ho Hu!

original: 現在正是雪荊州之恥的時候．
translated: Bay gio la luc phai trut bo noi xau ho cua Kinh Chau.

original: 抖擻精神準備出征吧！兄長，我們先準備！
translated: Hay chuan bi tinh than va san sang len duong! Anh em hay chuan bi truoc nhe!

original: 終於要與魏決戰了，請進行出征準備．
translated: Tran chien quyet dinh voi quan Nguy cuoi cung cung sap den, hay chuan bi xuat chinh.

original: 兄長，終於要與魏決戰了．我等兄弟的夢想，就要實現了．
translated: Anh oi, cuoi cung chung ta cung sap co tran chien quyet dinh voi Nguy. Giac mo cua anh trai toi sap tro thanh hien thuc.

original: 大哥，派我吧！沒多久，我們的夢想就實現了．
translated: Anh oi, gui cho em di! Khong mat nhieu thoi gian de uoc mo cua chung toi thanh hien thuc.

original: 完成伐魏大業吧．
translated: Hoan thanh dai nghiep chinh phuc nuoc Nguy.

original: 想早日報殺父之仇．
translated: Toi muon tra thu cho cai chet cua cha toi cang som cang tot.

original: 我也想為主公拼了我這把老骨頭．
translated: Toi cung muon chien dau bang xuong cot cu cua minh vi chua.

original: 快點出征吧！
translated: Nhanh len va tham chien!

original: 終於要與魏國決戰了．
translated: Cuoi cung cung den luc phai co tran chien quyet dinh voi Nuoc Nguoi.

original: 順路去洛陽與奇襲隊會合，在那裡重新編排部隊吧．
translated: Hay ghe qua Lac Duong de gap nhom dot kich va tai to chuc quan doi cua ban o do.

original: 奇襲隊眾將士，辛苦了．想必大家很疲勞，但還得一口氣進攻許昌！
translated: Cam on cac chien si cua doi tan cong bat ngo da lam viec cham chi. Moi nguoi chac han da rat met moi nhung van phai tan cong Hu Xu mot luot!

original: 進兵許昌吧！
translated: Hay hanh quan toi Hu Xu!

original: 請分派部隊．
translated: Hay phan bo quan doi.

original: 去洛陽吧．
translated: Den Lac Duong.

original: 此戰關係到魏國的命運，決不能輸！
translated: Tran chien nay lien quan den so phan cua Nuoc Nguoi va khong duoc phep thua!

original: 主公，聽說洛陽這裡的守將是曹真．
translated: Thua ngai, toi nghe noi nguoi canh giu Lac Duong o day la Cao Zhen.

original: 嗯，可是以我軍實力，拿下這裡易如反掌．
translated: Duoc roi, voi suc manh cua quan ta, viec chiem duoc noi nay se de dang.

original: 大意不得呀，小心進攻吧．
translated: Dung bat can, hay can than khi tan cong.

original: 當初玄德公的實力多麼渺小，現在如此壯大……我的眼光果然沒錯．
translated: Huyen Duc Cong luc dau thuc luc nho nhu vay, bay gio lai cuong dai nhu vay... Ta nhin qua nhien la dung.

original: 張飛嗎，久違了，有何指教？來勸降嗎？別開這樣的玩笑．
translated: Truong Phi, lau qua roi, co loi khuyen gi khong? Den thuyet phuc toi dau hang? Dung lam tro dua nhu vay.

original: 張郃，乾脆投降吧，魏國亡定了．
translated: Zhang He, chi can dau hang, nuoc Nguoi se phai chiu so phan.

original: 既然如此，只有打了！
translated: Trong truong hop nay, lua chon duy nhat la chien dau!

original: 啊！不愧……是……張飛，我不行了！
translated: a! Qua nhien... La... Truong Phi, toi khong the lam duoc nua!

original: ……真乃義士，令人敬佩．
translated: ... Anh ay thuc su la mot nguoi dan ong chinh truc va dang nguong mo.

original: 劉備軍如此強大……哎呀！
translated: Quan Luu Bi hung manh qua... Oi!

original: 主公，乘勢一鼓作氣進攻許昌吧！
translated: Chua oi, hay tan dung tinh the va tan cong Hu Xu mot luc!

original: 好，重新調兵遣將！
translated: Duoc roi, hay bo tri lai quan doi va tuong linh cua ban!

original: 全軍，進兵許昌．
translated: Toan quan tien ve Ho Hu.

original: 蜀軍，別那麼得意，我司馬懿想讓你們嘗嘗魏軍的厲害．
translated: Quan Thuc dung kieu ngao qua, ta Tu Ma Y muon nguoi nem thu suc manh cua quan Nguy.

original: 主公，敵軍統帥司馬懿是個對手，不能大意．請多留神．
translated: Thua chua, tuong giac Tu Ma Y la dich thu khong the khinh suat duoc. Hay chu y hon.

original: 我乃關羽之子關興！有誰敢與我單挑？
translated: Toi la Quan Hung, con trai cua Quan Vu! Ai dam thach thuc toi?

original: 哦，關羽的兒子嗎？如此，打起來也帶勁．好吧！我許褚與你單挑．
translated: O, con trai cua Quan Vu? Bang cach nay, no cung thu vi de chien dau. Duoc roi! Toi, Ho Thu, thach dau tay doi voi ban.

original: 成全你了！來吧！
translated: No da duoc thuc hien cho ban! mang no len!

original: 嘿，是許褚！有點真本事！
translated: Nay, la Ho Thu! Mot so ky nang thuc su!

original: 哈哈哈！我許褚還不老，不會輕易敗陣！來吧！
translated: Hahaha! Ta, Ho Thu, chua gia, se khong de dang bi danh bai! mang no len!

original: 嘿嘿嘿……！這刀如何！
translated: Hehehehe...! Con con dao nay thi sao!

original: 喂，且住！哈哈，還是年輕人體力足……我得撤了．
translated: Nay, o lai! Haha, nguoi tre van con du the luc... Toi phai rut lui.

original: 想逃跑！留下首級！
translated: Muon tron thoat! De lai cai dau phia sau!

original: 關興，以後再見！
translated: Quan Hung, hen gap lai!

original: 馬上趕去！還來得及參戰！
translated: Den do ngay bay gio! Van con thoi gian de tham gia tran chien!

original: 什麼？敵人的援軍？
translated: Cai gi? Quan tiep vien cua dich?

original: 主公，奇襲隊總算及時趕到了．
translated: Lay Chua, cuoi cung doi dot kich da den kip luc.

original: 好，全軍總攻擊．
translated: Duoc roi, toan quan tan cong.

original: 蜀軍好厲害呀！全軍先退回城裡！在城內消滅敵軍！
translated: Quan Thuc hung manh qua! Toan quan tro ve thanh pho truoc! Tieu diet luc luong dich trong thanh pho!

original: 大概魏軍要據守城池，怎麼辦？
translated: Co le quan Nguy muon thu thanh, chung ta phai lam sao?

original: 嗯，一口氣攻下這？孔明，那邊是？
translated: Cha, nam bat cai nay trong mot lan? Khong Minh, o do?

original: 哦，主公，好像奇襲隊趕到了．
translated: Oi chua oi, co ve nhu doi dot kich da den.

original: 如此甚好，全軍突擊許昌！
translated: Tot qua, toan quan tan cong Ho Hu!

original: 好，全軍突擊許昌！
translated: Duoc roi, toan quan tan cong Ho Hu!

original: 主公，請一定帶我去．讓您看看我這把老骨頭，還能上戰場廝殺．
translated: Lay Chua, xin hay dua con den do. Hay de toi cho ban thay rang xuong gia cua toi van co the chien dau tren chien truong.

original: 黃忠將軍，我也同去．主公，我倆去建奇功．
translated: Tuong Hoang Trung, toi di cung ong. Thua ngai, chung ta hay di va lap nen nhung thanh tuu to lon.

original: 嗯，如此甚好．
translated: Cha, dieu do rat tot.

original: 主公且慢．
translated: Chua oi, doi mot chut.

original: 怎麼了，孔明？
translated: Co chuyen gi vay Khong Minh?

original: 他們有點意氣太高，萬一有個閃失，會傷害全軍的銳氣．
translated: Ho co tinh than hoi qua cao. Neu co chuyen gi xay ra se lam ton hai den tinh than cua toan quan.

original: 軍師，瞧您說的．黃忠為了主公，萬死不辭．
translated: Co van quan su, hay xem ong noi gi. Hoang Trung se khong ngan ngai chet vi chua.

original: 一定讓我們參戰吧．
translated: Hay de chung toi tham gia cuoc chien.

original: 就如軍師所說．二位的心情我了解，這回還是多歇歇吧．
translated: Dung nhu co van quan su da noi. Toi hieu cam giac cua hai ban. Tot hon la nen nghi ngoi lan nay.

original: 主公！……知道了，從命．
translated: Chua oi! ...Toi biet, vang loi.

original: 請調兵遣將．
translated: Hay huy dong quan doi va tuong linh cua ban.

original: 劉備之流，與朕作對！朕身為大魏皇帝，這種態度，絕不容許！
translated: Luu Bi va dong bon cua han dang chong lai ta! Than la hoang de nha Nguy, ta se khong bao gio dung tung thai do nay!

original: 陛下，這座許昌城，不適合防守，請暫時撤退到鄴城吧．
translated: Be ha, thanh pho Ho Huc nay khong thich hop de phong thu. Hay tam thoi rut lui ve thanh pho Ye.

original: 司馬懿，朕如此狼狽，你要負責！
translated: Tu Ma Y, ta loan nhu vay, nguoi phai chiu trach nhiem!

original: 真愧對陛下．可是，現在不是責臣的時候，請……
translated: Toi that xau ho truoc be ha. Tuy nhien, bay gio khong phai la luc do loi cho quan chuc, xin hay...

original: 好吧，朕先去鄴城．司馬懿，你斷後，不要讓我見到蜀軍．
translated: Duoc roi, toi se den Yechen truoc. Tu Ma Y sau khi chia tay dung cho ta gap quan Thuc.

original: 哈哈……
translated: Ha ha……

original: 許昌城很大，易於進攻．一鼓作氣拿下城中心！
translated: Thanh pho Hu Xu rat rong lon va de bi tan cong. Di vao trung tam thanh pho trong mot lan!

original: 文遠，又見面了．
translated: Van Nguyen, chung ta lai gap nhau.

original: 關將軍，看來我好像跟錯主君了，董卓、呂布、還有……曹丕．曹丕哪像是曹操主公的兒子？竟然拋下臣子，簡直就像呂布……
translated: Tuong Quan, coi nhu di nham thay Dong Trac, Lu Bo, va... Tao Phi. Tao Phi giong con trai cua chua Tao Thao nhu the nao? Anh ta thuc su da bo roi cac bo truong cua minh, giong nhu Lu Bo...

original: 既然知錯，投降我們如何？
translated: Bay gio chung ta da biet loi cua minh, sao chung ta khong dau hang?

original: 什麼……？
translated: Cai gi……?

original: 下邳之戰，我被曹軍圍困於土山，正在絕望之際，你來見我，陳說利害．要死很容易，但什麼也解決不了．眼光放長遠些吧．
translated: Tran Ha Bi, ta bi quan Tao vay o Do Son. Khi toi tuyet vong, ban da den gap toi va bay to nhung so thich cua minh. Chet thi de nhung chang giai quyet duoc gi. Hay xem lau hon.

original: 當年我被你說的話打動，忍辱投降曹操．這次，我也用那話勸你．
translated: Toi rat cam dong truoc nhung gi ban noi den noi toi da dau hang trong su nhuc nha Tao Thao. Lan nay, toi se dung nhung loi tuong tu de khuyen ban.

original: 文遠，……意下如何？
translated: On Uyen,...ban nghi the nao?

original: ……好吧，投降．
translated: ...Duoc roi, dau hang.

original: 可是，讓我稍微平靜一下心緒．現在不想打了．
translated: Nhung hay de toi binh tinh lai mot chut. Toi khong muon chien dau bay gio.

original: 好吧，你先撤退．
translated: Duoc roi, cau rut lui truoc di.

original: 抱歉．
translated: Cam thay tiec.

original: 劉備，我會報此仇的！
translated: Luu Bi, ta se bao thu!

original: 什麼？城門沒開？嗯，如何是好……
translated: Cai gi? Cong thanh khong mo? Cha, toi nen lam gi day...

original: 黃忠老將軍，很容易就混進城了．
translated: Hoang Trung lao tuong len vao thanh de dang.

original: 是呀，因為能看見魏軍從這裡逃走，我想說不定能混進來．可惜沒捉到魏軍大將．
translated: Dung vay, boi vi nhin thay quan Nguy tron thoat tu day nen toi nghi co le minh co the len vao duoc. Dang tiec la tuong quan cua quan Nguy khong bi bat.

original: 可惜．捉住魏兵了嗎？
translated: long thuong xot. Ban da bat duoc Wei Bing chua?

original: 嗯，盤問魏兵，讓他招出如何從城門內側開門．如果打開城門，就是首功．軍師也會對我等另眼相看．
translated: Cha, hay tham van Wei Bing va yeu cau anh ta tim ra cach mo cua tu ben trong cong thanh. Neu mo duoc cong thanh thi do la thanh tuu dau tien. Co van quan su cung se nhin chung ta voi con mat khac.

original: 好，趕快去好嗎？
translated: Duoc roi, chung ta di nhanh thoi nhe?

original: 走，嚴老將軍！
translated: Di thoi, Tuong quan Yan!

original: 太好了，城門打開了！
translated: Tuyet voi, cong thanh da mo!

original: 主公，快請入城！
translated: Lay Chua, xin hay vao thanh pho nhanh len!

original: 黃忠！嚴顏！你們為何在此？
translated: Hoang Trung! Yen Nhan! Tai sao ban lai o day?

original: 見到敵軍從城中逃走，從他們逃出的地方進城的．
translated: Ho nhin thay quan dich dang chay tron khoi thanh pho va tu do ho chay vao thanh pho.

original: 城門已打開，請進來吧！
translated: Cong thanh da mo, moi vao!

original: 黃忠、嚴顏，你們幹得漂亮！
translated: Hoang Trung, Yan Yan, ban da lam rat tot!

original: 哈哈哈哈！人雖老了，但也不輸給年輕後生……！！
translated: Ha ha ha ha! Nguoi ta tuy gia nhung khong he thua kem nguoi tre...! !

original: 啊，沒想……到！有……伏兵！
translated: A, toi khong ngo... dieu do! Co... mot cuoc phuc kich!

original: 黃忠！嚴顏！不要緊吧！
translated: Hoang Trung! Yen Nhan! Dung ban tam!

original: 不礙事．主公，快……
translated: Khong can duong. Chua oi, nhanh len...

original: 好吧，別擔心！好好養傷！黃忠！嚴顏！來人，照看好二位老將軍！
translated: Dung lo lang! Hay cham soc ban than that tot nhe! Hoang Trung! Yen Nhan! Ai do, hay cham soc hai vi tuong gia nay!

original: 此作戰勝利是測試遊戲用的．如果遊戲進行到此，是遊戲的錯誤．
translated: Chien thang trong tran chien nay la de thu nghiem tro choi. Neu tro choi tiep tuc den thoi diem nay thi do la loi tro choi.

original: 司馬懿撤退了，劉備軍佔領許昌．
translated: Tu Ma Y rut lui, quan cua Lu Bi chiem Ho Hu.

original: 主公，我們勝利了！
translated: Lay Chua, chung con da thang!

original: 嗯！黃忠！黃忠怎麼樣了？嚴顏呢？
translated: Um! Hoang Trung! Hoang Trung the nao roi? Yen Yen dau?

original: 還活著，不過……
translated: Van con song, nhung...

original: 什麼！黃忠在哪？馬上去看黃忠！
translated: Cai gi! Hoang Trung o dau? Hay den gap Hoang Trung ngay nhe!

original: 啊！蜀軍如此厲害……向鄴城撤退！
translated: a! Quan Thuc hung manh... rut lui ve Nghiep Thanh!

original: 黃忠！嚴顏！許昌攻下來了，多虧你二人之力！
translated: Hoang Trung! Yen Nhan! Hu Xu da bi bat, nho co hai nguoi!

original: 哦，主公，恭喜……
translated: Oi chua oi, xin chuc mung...

original: 哦，曹丕……？殺了曹丕嗎？
translated: Oi, Tao Phi…? Giet Tao Phi?
abbrev: Oi, Tao Phi? Giet Tao Phi?

original: 嗯……殺了．
translated: Um... giet di.

original: 哦，太好了……如此，我死也瞑目了．
translated: O, tuyet voi... Bang cach nay, toi co the chet trong yen binh.

original: 哪裡話！復興漢室的大業還沒完，以後還仰仗二位！打起精神！這點箭傷沒什麼大礙！
translated: Co chuyen gi vay! Su nghiep vi dai phuc hung nha Han van chua ket thuc, tuong lai em van trong cay vao hai anh! reo ho! Vet thuong do mui ten nho nay khong co gi nghiem trong ca!

original: 主公……您能用我這老兵，太感謝您了．我們為主公盡力到最後，心中很寬慰．
translated: Lay Chua...cam on Ngai rat nhieu vi da su dung con nhu mot cuu chien binh. Chung toi da co gang het minh den cung vi chua va cam thay rat nhe nhom.

original: 怎麼樣……主公．和平的……沒有戰爭……盛世……
translated: The con... Chua oi. Hoa binh...khong chien tranh...thoi thinh vuong...

original: ……！黃忠！嚴顏！聽到我的聲音嗎？回答我！！
translated: ...! Hoang Trung! Yen Nhan! Ban co nghe thay giong noi cua toi khong? tra loi toi di! !

original: 第四章　蜀魏最後決戰
translated: Chuong 4 Tran chien quyet dinh cuoi cung giua Thuc va Nguy

original:
曹丕丟掉許昌後，在魏國最後的堡壘－鄴城集結全部兵馬，決心在此與蜀一決雌雄．
　另一方面，劉備在許昌重新派兵點將，蜀魏的最後決戰終於展開了．
translated:
Sau khi Tao Phi bo roi Ho Hu, ong tap hop toan quan o Nghiep Thanh, thanh tri cuoi cung cua Nuoc Nguoi, quyet tam the dien voi Thuc tai day.
Mat khac, Luu Bi lai bo tri quan va tuong o Ho Hu, tran chien quyet dinh cuoi cung giua Thuc va Nguy cuoi cung cung bat dau.

original: 在鄴城決戰！全軍向鄴城集結！絕不把魏國交給劉備之流！
translated: Tran chien quyet dinh o Yechen! Toan quan tap trung ve phia Nghiep thanh! Dung bao gio bo roi nuoc Nguoi cho nhung ke nhu Luu Bi!

original: 主公，向您報告．曹丕在鄴城集結了全部兵力，大概要與我軍決戰．
translated: Thua ngai, hay de toi bao cao voi ngai. Tao Phi da tap hop toan bo quan doi cua minh o Ye Cheng, va co le se quyet chien voi quan ta.

original: 嗯，這一時刻終於來了．
translated: Vang, thoi diem nay cuoi cung da den.

original: 既然這樣，已經什麼都不想了，只等廝殺！
translated: Trong truong hop nay, toi khong nghi den bat cu dieu gi nua, chi cho chien dau!

original: 是的！重振漢王朝的威嚴．
translated: Dung! Khoi phuc lai su uy nghiem cua nha Han.

original: 復興漢室！平息戰亂！
translated: Hoi sinh nha Han! Hay binh tinh chien tranh!

original: 大哥，我們多年來的夢想就要實現了．
translated: Anh a, uoc mo bao nam cua chung ta sap thanh hien thuc roi.

original: 正如三弟所說，兄長，我等三人的夢想就要成真了．
translated: Dung nhu loi anh ba noi, anh a, giac mo cua ba chung ta sap thanh hien thuc roi.

original: 主公，請快下令出征吧！
translated: Lay Chua, xin hay nhanh chong ra lenh cho cuoc tham hiem!

original: 主公，現在眾將士氣高漲，正是出擊的絕好機會．
translated: Lay Chua, tinh than cua cac tuong hien nay dang len cao va day la co hoi hoan hao de tan cong.

original: 嗯……往事不堪回首，一路苦難．我從平黃巾之亂起拯救亂世，與關、張二弟聯手，那時至今已歷多年．現在，終於到了結束這亂世的時候了．好不容易實現夙願．
translated: Cha... that kho de nhin lai qua khu va do la mot hanh trinh kho khan. Da nhieu nam troi qua ke tu khi toi dap tat Cuoc noi loan khan xep vang de cuu van thoi ky kho khan va hop luc voi nguoi anh thu hai la Quan va Truong. Bay gio, cuoi cung cung den luc ket thuc the gioi day rac roi nay. Cuoi cung cung thuc hien duoc tam nguyen ap u bay lau nay cua minh.

original: 主公，還不能鬆懈，為復興漢室，還有最後的大事．
translated: Chua oi, ngai van chua the thu gian duoc, van con nhung viec lon cuoi cung phai lam de hoi sinh nha Han.

original: 嗯……好！全體將士，開始準備出征．
translated: Um...tot! Tat ca binh linh bat dau chuan bi cho cuoc tham hiem.

original: 主公，再加把勁，討伐曹丕，復興漢室．
translated: Lay Chua, hay co gang hon nua de danh bai Tao Phi va hoi sinh nha Han.

original: 多謝您能用我這樣新來乍到的人，以後也請您多提攜．
translated: Cam on ban da loi dung mot nguoi moi nhu toi va toi hy vong ban se ho tro toi nhieu hon trong tuong lai.

original: 殺了曹丕，報亡父之仇，也為萬民報仇．願將其首級祭於亡父靈前．下命令吧！
translated: Giet Tao Phi de tra thu cho cai chet cua cha minh va tra thu cho toan dan. Toi xin hien te dau cua anh ay truoc linh hon nguoi cha da khuat cua anh ay. Hay ra lenh!

original: 吾與主公患難相隨，今後也將榮辱與共．這最後一戰，願冒死當先．
translated: Toi va chua da cung nhau trai qua nghich canh, tu nay tro di chung ta se cung chia se vui buon. Trong tran chien cuoi cung nay, toi san sang mao hiem mang song cua minh de dan dau.

original: 大哥，關鍵時刻到了．怎麼身子有些發顫！
translated: Anh oi, thoi khac quan trong da den. Tai sao co the toi run ray?

original: 怎麼了？還怕嗎？
translated: Co chuyen gi the? Ban van so a?

original: 瞧您說的！我這是精神抖擻，讓我出征！
translated: Hay nhin nhung gi ban noi! Toi tran day nang luong, hay de toi di ra ngoai!

original: 兄長，我等夙願就要實現了．
translated: Anh oi, dieu uoc ap u bao lau nay cua em sap thanh hien thuc roi.

original: 是啊！說實話，當時聽說二弟你敗走荊州時，我以為你以不在了……現在真好！
translated: Dung! Noi that luc nghe tin anh bi Kinh Chau nhi ca cua toi danh bai, toi tuong anh di roi… Gio thi tuyet roi!

original: 兄長說哪兒話，我等不是發誓寧願同死嗎？俺關羽絕不背棄誓言．兄長，我先準備準備．
translated: Anh trai toi da noi gi? Chang phai chung ta da the rang tha chet cung nhau sao? Toi, Quan Vu, se khong bao gio pha bo loi the cua minh. Anh oi, de em chuan bi truoc da.

original: 主公，我也準備去了．
translated: Chua oi, toi cung san sang di roi.

original: 龐統，若沒有你，有不會迎來今日，多謝了．
translated: Bong Thong, khong co ban, chung toi se khong co ngay hom nay. Cảm on rát nhièu.

original: 哪裡哪裡，實不敢當．我也蒙受主公知遇之恩，欣喜異常．好吧，我先去準備出征．
translated: Du o dau, toi thuc su khong dam coi trong no. Toi cung nhan duoc long tot cua chua toi va toi vo cung hanh phuc. Duoc roi, toi se di chuan bi cho chuyen tham hiem truoc.

original: 太好了．我也該準備……？
translated: Rat tot. Minh cung nen chuan bi nhi...?

original: 主公，就在此一戰了．
translated: Chua oi, day la noi tran chien bat dau.

original: 我們隨時接應．
translated: Chung toi luon san sang.

original: 黃忠！嚴顏！
translated: Hoang Trung! Yen Nhan!

original: ……？主公，怎麼了？
translated: ...? Chua oi, co chuyen gi the?

original: 嗨！……此時此刻，彷彿黃忠和嚴顏二位老將軍還在……
translated: CHAO! ...Luc nay, hinh nhu hai vi lao tuong Hoang Trung va Yan Yan van con o do...

original: ……．主公，請進去準備吧．
translated: ……． Lay Chua, xin hay vao trong va chuan bi.

original: 請調兵派將．
translated: Hay gui quan doi va tuong linh.

original: 向鄴城進軍！
translated: Hay hanh quan toi Nghiep Thanh!

original: 你們這些東西，侵犯朕的領土．這個國家是父親傳給我的，比什麼都重要，不能交給任何人．
translated: Cac ban dang xam chiem lanh tho cua toi. Dat nuoc nay duoc cha toi truyen lai cho toi. No quan trong hon bat cu dieu gi khac va khong the de lai cho bat cu ai.

original: 曹丕已來到城外決戰了，奮勇進攻吧！
translated: Tao Phi da den cho tran chien quyet dinh ben ngoai thanh pho, hay dung cam tan cong!

original: 來將可是曹彰？喂，那個黃毛小子！速來與我決戰！
translated: Tuong quan sap toi la Tao Chuong? Nay, cau be toc vang do! Hay den va chien dau voi toi!

original: 呸，少廢話，我曹彰可不是吃素的！
translated: Phu, dung noi nham nua, ta, Tao Chuong, khong phai nguoi an chay!

original: 真是對手，看我一戟？
translated: Ban co thuc su la mot doi thu? Ban co dinh cho toi mot don khong?

original: 哦，這……
translated: O, cai nay...

original: 招傢伙！
translated: Tuyen dung nhe cac ban!

original: 好險！
translated: That la mot rui ro!

original: 好小子！躲過去了！
translated: Chang trai tot! Hay tron di!

original: 該我的了．
translated: Den luot toi.

original: 哎呀！可惜……
translated: Oi! long thuong xot……

original: 刺中了！幹掉這小子！
translated: Dam! Giet ga nay!

original: 曹氏兄弟也親自出征了，好吧，看我宰了你！曹植，小心了！
translated: Anh em Tao cung dich than ra tran. Duoc roi, de ta giet nguoi! Cao Chi, hay can than!

original: 啊……既然如此，不戰也不行了．
translated: Ah... Trong truong hop nay, chung ta khong the lam gi neu khong chien dau.

original: 我乃關羽之子關興，曹植，你死定了！
translated: Toi la Quan Hung, con trai cua Quan Vu. Tao Chi, nguoi chet roi!

original: 打就打吧！
translated: Chi can chien dau!

original: 啊！
translated: a!

original: 曹植，宰你的是我關興！
translated: Tao Chi, la ta Quan Hung giet nguoi!

original: 哎呀！你們要幹什麼？朕可是大魏皇帝！
translated: Oi! Ban dinh lam gi? Toi la hoang de nha Nguy!

original: 殺了你，拯救亂世！準備受死吧！
translated: Giet ban va cuu the gioi gap kho khan! Chuan bi chet di!

original: 朕知道，可是朕還不想死！我投降！這總可以吧？
translated: Toi biet, nhung toi chua muon chet! Toi dau hang! Khong sao dau, phai khong?

original: 這也是曹操的兒子嗎？可悲，可嘆……
translated: Day cung la con trai cua Thao Thao? Buon, dang trach...

original: 哦，司馬懿！你去哪裡了？來，快殺了這群傢伙！
translated: Oi Tu Ma Y! ban da o dau the? Nao, giet bon nay di!

original: 是，如您所望，殺給你看……
translated: Dung, dung nhu nguoi du doan, ta se giet nguoi cho nguoi xem...

original: 嗯？司、司馬懿！你瘋了嗎？敵人在對面！為何以劍指朕？
translated: Um? Si, Tu Ma Y! Ban co dien khong? Ke thu o phia ben kia! Tai sao lai chia kiem vao toi?

original: 你這不成器的傢伙，玷汙了曹操主公一世盛名！我替他老人家懲罰你！
translated: Ke bat tai nhu nguoi da lam hoen o danh tieng cua Chua Tao Thao! Toi se trung phat anh thay anh ta!

original: 喂！司馬懿！住手！哇啊！！
translated: Xin chao! Tu Ma Y! dung lai! O! !

original: 劉備！曹丕雖死，但魏國不會滅亡，我將繼承曹操主公的意志！我在城內等你！
translated: Luu Bi! Tao Phi tuy co chet, Nuoc Nguoi se khong diet vong, ta se ke thua di chuc cua Tao Thao! Toi se doi ban trong thanh pho!

original: 究竟怎麼回事？
translated: Chuyen gi dang xay ra vay?

original: 不知道．能說的就是，大戰還沒結束．進攻城內吧！
translated: khong co y tuong Dieu co the noi la cuoc chien van chua ket thuc. Tan cong thanh pho!

original: 哈哈！如此魏國不會滅亡了！蜀軍，來受死吧！
translated: Ha ha! Nhu vay nuoc Nguoi se khong bi diet vong! Quan Thuc, den chet di!

original: 哦，怎麼？在自家城裡放火！
translated: O, cai gi? Hay dot chay thi tran cua chinh ban!

original: 敵人好像孤注一擲了，要麼徹底勝利，要麼寧為玉碎．
translated: Ke thu duong nhu da dua ra mot quyet dinh tuyet vong, hoac chien thang hoan toan hoac la cai chet.

original: 什麼？自家軍隊被火燒，也是預料之中？
translated: Cai gi? Chang le quan doi cua chinh minh se bi thieu rui?

original: 是的，這座城也保不住了，如果不撤退……啊！城門！
translated: Dung, thanh pho nay khong the duoc cuu. Neu chung ta khong rut lui...ah! Cong thanh!

original: 可惡！怎麼連退路都沒有！
translated: dang ghet! Tai sao khong co loi thoat!

original: 哈哈哈！燒死才好！曹操主公，來世再追隨您！
translated: Hahaha! Tha thieu chet han con hon! Tao Thao, chua oi, kiep sau con se theo ngai!

original: 主公，只有衝了．司馬懿肯定準備好了逃跑的路．
translated: Thua ngai, toi khong con lua chon nao khac ngoai viec phai voi vang. Tu Ma Y chac han da chuan bi san duong tron thoat.

original: 好，全體將士，捉住司馬懿！
translated: Duoc roi, toan quan bat Tu Ma Y!

original: 主公，危險！請趕快吧！
translated: Chua oi, nguy hiem! Lam on nhanh len!

original: 主公，請趕快！
translated: Chua oi, xin hay nhanh len!

original: 主公，趕快！
translated: Chua oi, nhanh len!

original: 主公，請趕快！城牆已不堅固了，危險！
translated: Chua oi, xin hay nhanh len! Buc tuong thanh khong con vung chac nua. Su nguy hiem!

original: 時候到了．劉備，再見了．和鄴城一起毀滅吧．
translated: Thoi co da den. Luu Bi, tam biet. Hay cung nhau tieu diet Yechen.

original: 主公，城崩塌了．
translated: Chua oi, thanh pho da sup do.

original: 什麼！啊！
translated: Cai gi! a!

original: 可惡……即使竭我之力，也無法遏制蜀軍……
translated: Chet tiet... Du co co gang het suc cung khong ngan duoc quan Thuc...

original: 司馬懿，等死吧！
translated: Tu Ma Y, cho chet di!

original: 呀！
translated: a!

original: 嗯？什麼聲音？
translated: Um? Am thanh gi?

original: 此聲……呀，但是，絕不……
translated: Am thanh nay...u, nhung khong bao gio...

original: 司馬懿，還沒結束！
translated: Tu Ma Y, van chua xong dau!

original: 哦，曹操主公！
translated: Oi Chua Tao Thao!

original: 什麼！是曹操！為何曹操……
translated: Cai gi! La Tao Thao! Tai sao Tao Thao…

original: 劉備，你把魏國折騰得夠苦，也就到此為止了．我正在此等著你，你運氣還可以．但是，打到我這裡……哈哈哈！
translated: Luu Bi, nguoi da hanh ha Nuoc Nguoi du roi va the la xong. Toi dang doi ban o day. Ban that may man. Nhung, danh toi vao day...hahaha!

original: 曹操主公，請稍等！
translated: Chua Tao Thao xin hay doi!

original: 怎麼回事？難道曹操沒死？
translated: Chuyen gi dang xay ra vay? Tao Thao chua chet?

original: 我也不知，可是……
translated: Toi cung khong biet, nhung...

original: 可是什麼？
translated: Nhung cai gi?

original: 現在看到的，也不是在夢裡吧？
translated: Nhung gi ban nhin thay bay gio khong phai la mot giac mo, phai khong?

original: 嗯……說曹操進去了，走，除了到裡面瞧瞧．也別無他法．
translated: Um...Tao Thao di vao, chung ta di thoi, ngoai tru viec nhin vao ben trong. Khong co cach nao khac.

original: 是，那我們進去吧．
translated: Vang, chung ta hay di vao.

original: 曹操，沒想到吧！你不是就要完了嗎！
translated: Dao Thao, khong ngo toi! Khong phai ban sap hoan thanh roi sao?

original: 連曹丕、司馬懿等人都被騙了，你一定不知道，好吧，我為你解釋一下．
translated: Ngay ca Tao Phi, Tu Ma Y va nhung nguoi khac cung bi lua. Ban khong duoc biet dieu do. Vang, hay de toi giai thich cho ban.

original: 魏、蜀、吳這三國，關係微妙，勢均力敵，互相牽制．如果這種狀況持續下去，我無法統一天下．所以，我決定詐死．
translated: Ba nuoc Nguy, Thuc, Ngo co moi quan he mong manh, ngang tai ngang suc, kiem che lan nhau. Neu tinh trang nay tiep tuc, toi se khong the thong nhat the gioi duoc. Vi vay, toi quyet dinh danh lua cai chet cua minh.

original: 詐死？
translated: Cai chet gia?

original: 正是．如果我死了，料想三國的平衡就打破了．接著，我播下了禍種，先殺了關羽，把責任推給東吳，想讓吳蜀相爭．
translated: Chinh xac. Neu toi chet, su can bang cua Tam Quoc se bi pha vo. Sau do ta gieo mam tai hoa, giet Quan Vu truoc, giao trach nhiem cho Dong Ngo, muon Ngo, Thuc danh nhau.

original: 什麼！如此說，吳、蜀相爭竟是曹操的圈套．
translated: Cai gi! Bang cach nay, xung dot giua Wu va Shu thuc chat la mot cai bay cua Tao Thao.

original: 正是．那時我已不在了，東吳可以安心與蜀作戰．就是那麼想的，可真沒想到蜀吳會結成同盟．劉備，你能容忍東吳，我萬沒想到．
translated: Chinh xac. Den luc do ta se di, Dong Ngo co the yen tam chien dau voi Thuc. Do la nhung gi toi nghi, nhung toi thuc su khong ngo rang Shu va Wu lai lien minh voi nhau. Luu Bi, toi khong ngo anh co the chiu dung duoc Dong Ngo.

original: 蜀吳兩敗俱傷，不論哪家滅亡了，剩下的另一家都已元氣大傷．那時再出擊，可輕易取勝，於是，魏國就可統一天下．這正是我的如意算盤，……沒想到我錯了．
translated: Ca Thuc va Ngo deu bi ton that. Du gia dinh nao bi tieu diet thi gia dinh con lai cung bi thiet hai nang ne. Luc do neu tan cong lai thi co the de dang gianh chien thang, nhu vay nuoc Nguoi moi co the thong nhat thien ha. Day dung la dieu toi da du tinh... Toi khong ngo rang minh da sai.

original: 而且，將國家交給曹丕等人也是大錯，這個國家輕易地毀在那傢伙手裡．這座美麗的城市，也如此狼狽．
translated: Hon nua, se la mot sai lam lon neu giao dat nuoc cho Tao Phi va nhung nguoi khac. Dat nuoc co the de dang bi pha huy trong tay ke do. Thanh pho xinh dep nay cung dang trong tinh trang hon loan nhu vay.

original: 但是，還不會就這麼結束！打敗你，合併魏、蜀兩國，再統一天下．劉備，不要妨礙我的夢想的實現．
translated: Nhung no khong ket thuc o do! Danh bai ban, hop nhat Nguy va Thuc, roi thong nhat the gioi. Luu Bi, dung can tro viec thuc hien uoc mo cua toi.

original: 曹操，你那樣的想法製造了世上的戰亂，是萬民塗炭的元兇！董卓、呂布、袁紹、袁術……，這些人，都只顧自己．曹操，你也和他們一樣．
translated: Tao Thao, nhung suy nghi nhu the cua ban da tao ra chien tranh tren the gioi va la thu pham gay ra su huy hoai cua toan the nhan loai! Dong Trac, Lu Bo, Vien Thieu, Vien Thu... nhung nguoi nay chi biet lo cho minh ma thoi. Tao Thao, ban cung giong nhu ho.

original: 什麼！說我與董卓之流一樣！混蛋……！
translated: Cai gi! Hay goi toi giong nhu Dong Trac va dong loai cua anh ay! do khon……!

original: 曹操，天下人已容不下你！亂國害君，你不死無以謝天下．
translated: Tao Thao, the gioi khong con co the dung thu cho ban nua! Hon loan dat nuoc va lam hai nha vua, ban se khong the cam on the gioi cho den khi ban chet.

original: 來將可是許褚．張飛在此，特來送你見閻王，許褚，一決勝負．
translated: Vi tuong sap toi la Ho Thu. Truong Phi toi day de dua ban den gap Diem vuong Ho Thu de danh mot tran quyet chien.

original: 呸！張飛，過來受死！
translated: Oi! Truong Phi, di chet di!

original: 哦，果然有兩下子！
translated: O, chac chan roi!

original: 看不出，你還有兩手！呀！
translated: Toi khong the thay rang ban van con co hai tay! a!

original: 難決勝負．張飛，這刀結束你算了．
translated: That kho de quyet dinh ket qua. Truong Phi, con dao nay dung xong thi quen di.

original: 來呀！
translated: Co len!

original: 不過如此！
translated: Nhung chi the thoi!

original: 真可惜．
translated: That dang tiec.

original: 殺了我吧．
translated: Giet toi di.

original: 死吧！
translated: Chet di!

original: ……剛才真驚險．
translated: …Vua roi that la hoi hop.

original: 張遼……
translated: Truong Lieu…

original: 關羽……
translated: Quan Vu…

original: 張遼，我和你勢必一戰……
translated: Truong Lieu, nguoi va ta nhat dinh phai danh nhau...

original: 什麼也別說了．來吧，亮武器吧！
translated: Dung noi gi ca. Nao, khoe vu khi cua ban!

original: 關羽！別愣著！好好打！不然，會被我殺了！來吧！
translated: Quan Vu! Dung choang vang! Tot chien dau! Neu khong ta se giet nguoi! mang no len!

original: 張遼，死定了！
translated: Truong Lieu, chet roi!

original: 哎呀！！不好！
translated: Oi! ! khong tot!

original: 別那麼傷心．現在，我感覺很清爽，為了我所效忠的君主……而死．士為知己者死，這是我的夢想……沒想到現在實現了．
translated: Dung buon the. Bay gio toi cam thay rat sang khoai, duoc chet vi vi quan chu ma toi trung thanh... Uoc mo cua mot thu sinh la duoc chet vi tri ky cua minh... Khong ngo bay gio lai thanh hien thuc.

original: 可是，我……發生了這樣的結果……
translated: Nhung, toi... chuyen nay da xay ra...

original: 關羽，如果當年在下邳沒有你，也到不了今日．有……禮了，多……謝了！
translated: Quan Vu, neu khong co cau o Ha Bi thi chung ta khong co ngay hom nay. Cảm on rát nhièu!

original: 張遼……為什麼？注定要如此悲慘的結局！嗚！！
translated: Truong Lieu…tai sao? Dang le phai co mot ket cuc bi tham nhu vay! Oi! !

original: 李典！與我決一死戰！
translated: Ly Dien! Hay chien dau den chet voi toi!

original: 既然如此，我也無計可施．趙雲，放馬過來！
translated: Trong truong hop nay, toi khong the lam gi duoc. Trieu Van, toi day!

original: 啊，魏國也要亡了……
translated: A, Nuoc Nguoi cung sap chet roi...

original: 樂進！在渭水多蒙你”關照”！現在在此，我要報仇雪恨！看招！
translated: Lejin! Cam on cac ban da “cham soc” song Vi! Bay gio toi muon tra thu! Xem di chuyen!

original: 嘿！
translated: Chao!

original: 哼！渭水之恨，稍稍得雪！
translated: khit mui! Su thu han cua song Weishui da co duoc mot chut tuyet!

original: 我要出征了．
translated: Toi dang di tham hiem.

original: 太好了，哈哈哈……劉備，沒想到我預先在城中做了手腳．啊，火啊，著得好！用火打斷劉備軍！
translated: Tuyet, hahaha... Luu Bi, khong ngo truoc do toi da lam vai tro lo trong thanh. Ah, lua, thap sang qua! Dung lua chan quan cua Luu Bi!

original: 哦，主公，前面路上！
translated: Oi chua oi, tren con duong phia truoc!

original: 什麼事……
translated: Co chuyen gi the……

original: 哈哈哈！燒吧，燒吧！用火攻，將你們打斷！
translated: Hahaha! Dot di, dot di! Su dung cac cuoc tan cong lua de lam gian doan ban!

original: 啊！還有火！
translated: a! Va lua!

original: 別管城中之事了！打敗你們這些人，天下就盡歸曹公了！劉備！孔明！為了曹公，一定消滅你們！
translated: Dung lo lang ve nhung gi dang xay ra trong thanh pho! Neu chung toi danh bai cac nguoi, the gioi se thuoc ve Tao Cong! Luu Bi! Khong Minh! Vi Tao Cong, ta nhat dinh se tieu diet nguoi!

original: 正是如此，司馬懿，這是最後決戰，在這裡只許勝不准敗．
translated: The day, Tu Ma Y, day la tran chien cuoi cung, chi duoc phep thang chu khong duoc phep thua.

original: 劉備，當年，在許昌的花園煮酒論英雄，那時的話還記得嗎？當時說到最後，只有兩個英雄，就是你我二人……我的眼力還是沒有錯．
translated: Luu Bi, ngay ay chung ta nau ruou ban luan anh hung trong vuon Ho Hu. Ban con nho nhung gi anh ay noi luc do khong? Khi do, cuoi cung chi co hai anh hung la ban va toi... Thi luc cua toi van con binh thuong.

original: 如果你不背叛我，與我同舟共濟的話，我也許走的是另一條路吧．或者還是……嗨，現在說這些都晚了．
translated: Neu ban khong phan boi toi va o lai voi toi, co le toi da di mot con duong khac. Hoac... Nay, bay gio da qua muon de noi dieu nay roi.

original: 劉備，不管怎麼說，我二人相爭已是天命，現在就是決定命運的時候，你來得正好！
translated: Luu Bi, du the nao di nua, dinh menh cua hai chung ta la phai chien dau. Bay gio la luc quyet dinh so phan cua chung ta. Ban da den dung luc!

original: 哼！劉、劉備……！你把我的夢想……都攪亂了……！啊！！
translated: khit mui! Luu, Luu Bi...! Ban da lam xao tron tat ca nhung giac mo cua toi...! a! !

original: 成功了，終於打敗曹操！
translated: Thanh cong, cuoi cung da danh bai duoc Tao Thao!

original: 主公，大功告成了．
translated: Chua oi, xong roi.

original: 大哥，恭喜您了，實現了多年的願望，真不容易．
translated: Anh trai, xin chuc mung. That khong de dang de thuc hien duoc mong muon cua ban trong nhieu nam.

original: 啊，等太久了．
translated: A, lau qua roi.

original: 去迎接聖上吧！
translated: Hay di chao Duc Thanh!

original: 好！高奏凱歌回洛陽！
translated: Tot! Ve Lac Duong khuc ca khai hoan!

original: 洛陽宮殿
translated: Cung Lac Duong

original: 在鄴城取得勝利、凱旋回洛陽的劉備等人，再次迎回被逐出京都的獻帝．
translated: Luu Bi va nhung nguoi khac, nhung nguoi da gianh chien thang o Yechen va tro ve Lac Duong trong chien thang, mot lan nua chao don Hoang de Xian da bi truc xuat khoi Kyoto.

original: ~沒想到真的又能回到這裡了，這一切都多虧了皇叔，謝皇叔．
translated: ~ Khong ngo co the quay lai day lan nua. Tat ca dieu nay la nho chu cua toi, cam on ban.

original: 哪裡，臣來遲了，萬望恕罪．陛下，請登寶座．
translated: Khong, toi den muon. Toi xin loi. Xin be ha hay len ngoi.
